descriptions.zh: 离经叛道、扰乱人心的公开展览点饰着[owner.GetName]的日常。他们的出发点看上去是好的，艺术上极具表现力——但是这种艺术对于我们社会更广泛的层面会造成什么样的影响呢？
descriptions.en: Day-to-day life in the [owner.GetName] is colored by eccentric and disruptive public displays. Their purpose appears benign, and artistically expressive - but what influence might this art have on our wider society?

descriptions.zh:
命运之重张牙舞爪，我们在悬崖边缘战战兢兢，其下是血一般的未来。

当我们凝视着深渊时，深渊中只有我们在回望着自己。
descriptions.en:
We balance over the chasm of a bloody future as the gravity of destiny claws at us.

As we gaze into the abyss, we see only ourselves staring back.

descriptions.zh:
一套早已过期的秘密代码刚刚被重新传送到了我方，这涉及到我们在§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!已经开展的行动。

某个我们曾经除名的情报人员正试图汇报，此人宣称携带了关于一个位于[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]的§H关键政治人物§!情报的标记——但是，这些早已作废的代码能够信任吗？
descriptions.en:
A long-expired set of covert codes has been re-transmitted to us, linked to Operations we previously carried out in the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!.

A once-disavowed operative is apparently trying to report back in, claiming to possess intelligence on §Hkey political figures§! in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] - but can these expired codes be trusted?
